architectureDecisions: D1 — Additive DELIVER_SLICE_V1 optional acceptance={version:"LOCAL_ACCEPTANCE_V1",manifestPath:absolutePath,manifestSha256:64-lowercase-hex}. Omission preserves legacy behavior and claim boundary, adding acceptance:null; protected results use assurance EXTERNALLY_PINNED_TRUSTED_LOCAL. Presence requires strict validation; null/unknown keys/version/missing digest is TypeError DELIVER_SLICE_V1 invalid (CLI usage 64), never silent downgrade. Operator supplies expected digest before dispatch; agent output cannot choose/recompute authority.

D2 — local-acceptance.js exports pinLocalAcceptance({slice,worktreeRoots}), bindSliceAcceptance({slice,pin,recoveryDir,handleExists}), runLocalAcceptance({pin,workspaceRoot,candidateSha,sliceId}). Strict manifest: {version:"LOCAL_ACCEPTANCE_MANIFEST_V1",objectiveSha256,entryPoint,files:[{path,sha256}],runtime:{path,sha256},args:[string],timeoutMs,protectedPaths:[relativePOSIXPath]}. files/protectedPaths nonempty and unique; entryPoint is listed .mjs; timeout positive integer; runtime absolute pinned Node executable. Hash raw manifest/files/runtime bytes. objectiveSha256 hashes UTF-8 recursively sorted-key canonical JSON {id,repositoryRoot:realpath,baseRevision,prompt}; preserve array order. Reject unknown keys/digest shape, credentials in config, unsafe/control-character paths, .git segments, globs/backslashes, symlink components, directories/submodules and non-SHA1 Git repos.

D3 — Resolve realpaths and path.relative containment; enumerate git worktree list --porcelain -z. Manifest/evaluator/runtime/recovery snapshot must be outside source repo and every linked worktree, explicitly including Backend/QA roots. files/entryPoint remain within manifest directory. Read complete git ls-tree -r -z --full-tree baseRevision and select exact protected filenames in memory, avoiding path-pattern interpretation. Pin {path,mode,type,oid} for existing regular blobs 100644/100755; compare exact candidate tuple. Modification/deletion/rename/mode/type change fails PROTECTED_PATH_CHANGED. Other tests may change/add but cannot replace independent external assertions.

D4 — Before dispatch snapshot verified manifest/listed evaluator bytes outside worktrees, preserving relative files. Private/nonwritable modes are hygiene, not same-uid isolation. Run pinned absolute runtime with [absoluteSnapshotEntryPoint,...manifest.args,realpath(candidateCheckout)] and cwd=candidateCheckout, shell:false. Last arg is exact candidate root. Support trusted self-contained evaluator or declared siblings/Node builtins; unlisted third-party acceptance dependencies/dynamic downloads unsupported. No automatic import-closure or evaluator-adequacy certification: operator-pinned no-op evaluator cannot establish quality.

D5 — runDeliverSlice pins/binds before any Backend/resume/QA/disposal side effect; never expose acceptance files/config through backendTaskFor/prompt. After Backend ACCEPTED, use existing fresh detached QA checkout; require clean HEAD==candidateSha, tree==candidateSha^{tree}. Compare protected tuples, run ordinary QA, then external evaluator on SAME checkout only if ordinary QA passes. runLocalAcceptance composes createLocalCommandVerifier(claim:acceptance.external,requireUnchangedTree:true), pinned runtime/argv and delivered BB-130 child environment semantics. Preserve full revision/exit/reason/stdout-stderr SHA256 evidence and bounded summary; no package dependency reversal.

D6 — Immediately pre/post evaluation verify original manifest/files, snapshot files and runtime digests, HEAD/tree/working state. Missing/drift never passes. Timeout is INCONCLUSIVE, signal/spawn/nonzero errors FAIL; both return QA_FAILED. Always finally-clean QA and ephemeral acceptance scratch. Trust boundary: trusted operator/adapter/evaluator, stable Git/runtime, no concurrent adversarial writers; external means outside checkout, not OS-inaccessible under one uid. Persistent substitution is detected; malicious write-and-restore, runtime/native escapes and collusion require BB-067 confinement. No value/publication authority claim.

D7 — Result acceptance={profile:"LOCAL_ACCEPTANCE_V1",assurance:"EXTERNALLY_PINNED_TRUSTED_LOCAL",status:PASS|FAIL|INCONCLUSIVE,reason,objectiveSha256,contractSha256,manifestSha256,evaluatorFiles:[{path,sha256}],runtime:{path,sha256},protectedBase:[{path,mode,type,oid}],candidateSha,candidateTree,verification:fullVerifierRecord}. Protected ACCEPTED requires non-null PASS, candidateSha==backendSha and exact tree. Operational preflight failure returns QA_FAILED/backendSha:null/qa:null/acceptance:FAIL with available bindings; CLI prints JSON exit 1. Retain existing ACCEPTED=0/TOOL_UNAVAILABLE=2/usage=64. Reasons include ACCEPTANCE_MANIFEST_INVALID, ACCEPTANCE_DIGEST_MISMATCH, OBJECTIVE_MISMATCH, PROTECTED_PATH_CHANGED, ACCEPTANCE_BINDING_MISMATCH and delivered verifier reasons.

D8 — Deliver-owned acceptance-binding.json in external recoveryDir: {version:"DELIVER_ACCEPTANCE_BINDING_V1",sliceId,repositoryRoot,baseRevision,contractSha256,acceptance:pinnedIdentityOrNull}. Contract hashes normalized objective/profile, real manifest/snapshot locations, all file/runtime pins, argv/timeout, qaVerifications and protected base tuples; null binds legacy QA too. Persist snapshot then sidecar atomically before first runSupervisedTask (exclusive temp+rename, serialized single owner). Every existing handle status, including ACCEPTED/HANDLE_COMPLETE/terminal, requires equal well-formed sidecar before resume/QA/dispose. Added/removed/changed acceptance, missing/corrupt/foreign sidecar fails with explicit restart instruction and no fresh fallback/state deletion. No-handle same sidecar permits pre-dispatch restart only after proving handle file absent; corrupt handle is not absence. Keep snapshot across interruption, rehash on resume, cleanup only owned terminal state. Never cache external PASS: accepted handle independently evaluates exact candidate again. On resume reuse the persisted snapshot path; never generate a replacement snapshot/root or compare a newly generated random path. Failed validation preserves all existing snapshot/sidecar/handle bytes.

D9 — BB-104 delivered fresh QA/source preservation is reused; BB-125 owns exact task/execution/model/permission/launch handle binding and BB-130 owns verifier env. Both are PLANNED_CONTRACT, not delivered fixes. Require all direct dependencies DONE and reread exact APIs before Worker; contradictions return to research. No BB-125 handle schema change or new general evaluator framework; BB-099 separation informs authority without reopening terminal claims.

D10 — Focused tests use scratch Git and deterministic fake Backend adapters, no credentials/providers. Each distinct negative body directly invokes bound product symbol and asserts failure reason/no ACCEPTED plus dispatch/verifier/disposal counters where relevant. Positive: genuine addition fix and fresh replay with same pins/exact SHA-tree; allowed UNPROTECTED test edit with independent evaluator and unchanged separate protected file. Cover protected tuple matrix, no-op QA, runtime/config/goal tamper, postcheck drift, unchanged interrupted resume, complete-handle replay, CLI and legacy null. Source repository snapshot remains identical.

D11 — Executed seven-case scratch prototype uses delivered runSliceQa plus experimental digest/protected-entry gate: ordinary no-op QA passes broken candidate; external assertions reject broken/weakened tests; protected change, evaluator replacement, missing pin and candidate mismatch rejected; real implementation fix passes. This is research feasibility, not implementation of new exports/durable resume/fresh delivery. Worker evidence must invoke product seams at candidate. Independent fresh Jev still required.

D12 — Update only declared Living state/observation after Worker delivery: manifest/evidence API, optional legacy/null, operator assertion ownership, trusted-process scope, resume restart rules; no Blackboard ids/research statuses. CLI help describes acceptance in slice manifest only; preserve unrelated operator factor work and status/exit routing.

reproduction: Scratch os.tmpdir repo plus external operator directory. Base sum.mjs exports (a,b)=>a-b; sum.test.mjs asserts sum(2,3)==5. Commit. Write evaluatorSource externally; hash raw bytes and record git ls-tree base -- sum.test.mjs tuple.

At each commit call delivered runSliceQa({workspaceRoot:repo,acceptedSha:HEAD,qaVerifications:[{name:"repo-noop",command:process.execPath,args:["-e","process.exit(0)"],timeoutMs:2000}]}). Experimental gate checks candidate==HEAD, external digest==expected, optional protected tuple, then spawnSync(process.execPath,[evaluator,repo],{cwd:repo,env:{PATH:process.env.PATH},timeout:2000}); require exit 0.

Broken base external FAIL; commit assertion-free test and external FAIL; protected comparison rejects. Replace external evaluator with process.exit(0) while retaining pin: digest rejection. Restore bytes and set expected pin null: rejection. Restore base test and change sum to (a,b)=>a+b: PASS. Supply base candidate identity while at real fix: revision rejection. assert.equal every expected result; capture SHA/tree; finally remove scratch. Commit SHAs vary on replay; evaluator digest/results do not.
